remarks: BEST & FINAL offers by Noon on Tuesday, 4/15. Welcome to this perfect townhouse centrally located in Glenbrook! This stunning, turn-key home is brimming with charm, warmth, and modern upgrades. The home's fresh and bright interior is perfectly balanced by the rich dark hardwood floors and exposed wood throughout the main level. The kitchen, located in the heart of the home - has been beautifully remodeled with gleaming stainless steel appliances, a natural gas cooktop, sleek subway tile backsplash, and all the essentials for the modern chef. Off the kitchen, find a dedicated dining area to make entertaining a breeze, leading right into the large, cozy living room complete with a fireplace and two sliding glass doors that open up to a spacious deck, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living. The main floor also boasts a half bath conveniently located for guests. Upstairs, you'll find brand new carpets and two generously sized bedrooms, one of which has an en suite bathroom. The other updated, full bathroom is comfortably located in the hallway. The finished basement offers an impressive 885 square feet, providing an additional living space that could be used as a play/rec room, office, living room or anything else you can imagine! The space also provides an additional, separate storage/laundry room. Conveniently located within walking distance to the Glenbrook train, great food, shopping and all that Stamford has to offer. See this incredible unit quickly before it is gone
